rewrites.yea_description: Voted for Assembly Bill 91, a bill letting the parole board take a second look at people serving time for serious felonies after ten years. The Nevada Assembly passed it 27-15, but the Senate never voted on it, so it never became law.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against Assembly Bill 91, a bill letting the parole board take a second look at people serving time for serious felonies after ten years. The Nevada Assembly passed it 27-15, but the Senate never voted on it, so it never became law.

rewrites.yea_description: Voted for Senate Bill 391, a bill to cap corporate purchases of Nevada homes at 100 a year. Nevada requires a two-thirds majority for a bill that creates a fee, so the Senate's 13-8 vote was not enough and the bill failed.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against Senate Bill 391, a bill to cap corporate purchases of Nevada homes at 100 a year. Nevada requires a two-thirds majority for a bill that creates a fee, so the Senate's 13-8 vote was not enough and the bill failed.
